The bank's policy of conducting background checks on new employees in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) is compliant with federal regulations. The FCRA requires employers to obtain written consent from applicants before conducting background checks, provide proper notice if adverse action is taken based on the report, and follow specific procedures regarding the use of consumer reports. By aligning their hiring practices with these standards, the bank is adhering to legal requirements.
